QB.name: Lamar Jackson

deep_ball.how: pass yards per attempt divided by 12, capped at 1

scramble.how: rush yards divided by pass plus rush yards

QB.notes: Efficient passer at every depth who scores over the middle and adds explosive runs. Third down is his weak spot, and he has barely played since week 4. Season 2026 numbers through game week 6.0 (5.0 games). Made by Scout's tools, researched in Juan's laptop session: stats step with find_player, season_stats, compute_tendencies and write_profile; film room and fact-check in data/profiles/notes/PYT-QB-report.md.
